thread:
Maria N: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we captured action items but need to lock owners/timelines for GPU quota, scheduler tuning, and headroom planning. posting short owner + ETA proposals.

Maria N: ACTION-1: quota guardrails — add hard/soft limits per team, emergency backstop. proposal: Devon to own, ETA: 5 business days.

Devon L: taking ACTION-1. quick Q: do we scope per-project or per-org? prefer per-project to avoid noisy tenants.

Maria N: per-project + org-defaults. add an override path for SRE during incidents.

Maria N: ACTION-2: scheduler tuning — reduce preemption churn and increase bin-packing for short-gen jobs. Kai to prototype a config change and run a 48h canary. ETA: 7 days.

Kai S: got it. initial plan: tweak scheduler backfill window from 30s -> 120s and enable packed scheduling for <64-token workloads. small snippet to test:
```
# scheduler config fragment
preemption: false
backfill_window_seconds: 120
bin_packing: enabled
```
I'll run canary on staging tomorrow and report perf deltas.

Maria N: ACTION-3: headroom playbook — define minimum idle GPU headroom per region + surge plan (burst pool + cross-region fallback). Amanda to own ops docs + runbook. ETA: 10 business days.

Amanda R: I'll own ACTION-3. plan: 1) define headroom targets from 99th pct demand spikes, 2) implement automated alerts when headroom < threshold, 3) add runbook steps for manual burst and cross-region failover. ETA sounds fine.

Devon L: for quota guardrails, we should add a soft alarm at 70% and hard deny at 95% for non-critical projects. want to prototype a policy in quota-service this week.

Kai S: note — scheduler tweak may change latency profile for short jobs. I'll include latency histograms in the canary dashboard and add a regression alert: if P95 latency increases >15% revert.

Amanda R: shoutout — does SRE have capacity to own the emergency override path? I can draft doc but need someone to approve/execute during incident.

Maria N: SRE oncall should be approvers. @sre-bot can we add a workflow to escalate to oncall and trigger quota overrides with TTL?

sre-bot: Created ticket INF-5824 to add automated escalation and TTL-based overrides. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INF-5824 :white_check_mark:

Devon L: I'll start quota policy PR today and tag reviewers.

Kai S: canary scheduled 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC, will publish dashboard link in this thread once live.

Amanda R: drafting headroom runbook now, will share first pass by EOD Friday. :pencil2:

Maria N: thanks all — I'll consolidate owners/ETAs into the postmortem follow-up doc and create a weekly checkpoint until all actions are closed. next check-in in 7 days. :calendar: :eyes:

Devon L: :thumbsup:

Kai S: :shipit:
